yash highvoltage.details: Yash Highvoltage specializes in producing a variety of transformer bushings including OIP, RIP, RIS condenser bushings, high voltage and high current bushings, OIP wall bushings, and oil to oil bushings.

yashhtej india.details: Yashhtej Industries (India) Ltd. is a public agribusiness company engaged in manufacturing soybean crude oil and soybean de-oiled cake for the edible oil and animal feed industry. The company is expanding into edible oil refining and renewable energy projects to strengthen operations.

zelio e mobility.details: Manufactures electric two-wheelers (Zelio) and three-wheelers (Tanga). An ISO-certified company focused on producing eco-friendly vehicles with benefits like lower emissions and energy sustainability.
